description: v14 measured data: block-selection curve; descent differentials; envelope distributions; kernel measurements.

descent_differentials.description: Exhaustive and large-sample differentials of the v14 descent node mechanics, run at toy scale (tower |u|=4) on the host with fresh research code; the sandbox experiment [8] reproduces the machinery at sampled scope.

functional_differential.description: per-(prime, root pair) congruence functional vs exact ideal membership, 12-dim reduced lattices

exhaustive_threshold_differential.description: full 3^12 boxes, thin window: exhaustive exact norms and TD relation decision per cell

envelope_study.description: cf/cg over 16 actual special-q lattices (q in [2^70,2^260]), exact LLL, 6144 norm pairs

descent_differentials.block_selection_curve: the selection curve table in this file (all 2401 rows, 113342 certified blocks)

relation_differential.description: fat-window regime with true relations: full survivor path validated; unfactored survivors conservatively rejected
